functions.name: fd_first_free
functions.summary: Finds first free descriptor index in fd bitmap starting at low
functions.contract: /*@ requires low >= 0 && size >= 0; ensures low >= size ==> result == low; ensures low < size && result < size ==> NDBIT(result) & ~fdp->fd_map[NDSLOT(result)] != 0 && (\forall int i; low <= i < result ==> NDBIT(i) & fdp->fd_map[NDSLOT(i)] != 0); ensures low < size && result == size ==> (\forall int i; low <= i < size ==> NDBIT(i) & fdp->fd_map[NDSLOT(i)] != 0); */

loops.shape: linear scan of bitmap slots from off to NDSLOTS(size)
loops.invariant: all slots before off are all-ones, and all bits below off*NDENTRIES in [low, off*NDENTRIES) are set

functions.error_convention: returns size (sentinel) when no free bit found
functions.model_hint: bitmask of used fds with first-zero search

functions.prose_contract: Precondition: the descriptor table has at least one slot. Postcondition: returns the index of the highest set bit in the map (the last used fd), or -1 if the map is empty.

loops.shape: reverse scan of bitmap slots from NDSLOT(fd_nfiles-1) down to 0
loops.invariant: all slots above off contain only zero bits

functions.error_convention: returns -1 when no descriptors are in use

functions.name: _pmap_alloc_l3

functions.name: reclaim_pv_chunk_domain

functions.error_convention: returns negative error code propagated from callbacks, 0 on success

functions.prose_contract: Precondition: parent is the root directory at the given level covering [addr, end). functions.ownership: Borrowed pointers; caller owns the page-table tree.
functions.error_convention: returns negative error code from callbacks, 0 on success
functions.model_hint: restricted traversal of a trie visiting only nodes shared across address ranges

functions.prose_contract: Precondition: dev has valid dma_priv and dma_mask. Postcondition: on success returns initialized pool with tag, zone, mutex, and pctrie ready; on tag-creation failure frees pool and returns NULL.
functions.ownership: caller owns returned pool, freed by linux_dma_pool_destroy
functions.model_hint: pool handle bundling tag, zone, mutex, pctrie

functions.name: linux_dma_pool_destroy
functions.summary: Tear down pool: destroy zone, tag, lock, free struct
functions.prose_contract: Precondition: pool was created by linux_dma_pool_create and holds no outstanding objects. Postcondition: zone, DMA tag, and mutex are destroyed and pool memory freed.
functions.ownership: consumes the caller's pool reference

functions.name: lkpi_dmam_pool_destroy
functions.summary: Reclaim pctrie entries then destroy the pool stored at p
functions.prose_contract: Precondition: *(struct dma_pool **)p is a live pool. Postcondition: all pctrie objects are reclaimed and the pool is destroyed.
functions.ownership: consumes pool pointer stored at p

functions.name: linux_dma_pool_alloc
functions.summary: Allocate pool object, insert into pctrie keyed by dma_addr, return vaddr
functions.prose_contract: Precondition: pool is a live dma_pool. Postcondition: on success *handle holds the object's dma_addr, the object is in the pctrie, and the kernel vaddr is returned; on any failure returns NULL and no state is leaked.
functions.ownership: caller must free via linux_dma_pool_free
functions.error_convention: NULL on failure, rolls back zone allocation on insert failure
functions.model_hint: pctrie keyed by dma_addr mapping to object with vaddr

functions.name: linux_dma_pool_free
functions.summary: Look up object by dma_addr in pctrie, remove, return to zone
functions.prose_contract: Precondition: dma_addr was produced by linux_dma_pool_alloc on this pool. Postcondition: if found, the object is removed from the pctrie and returned to the zone; unknown dma_addr is a silent no-op.
functions.ownership: consumes the caller's object reference
functions.model_hint: pctrie keyed by dma_addr

functions.name: linux_backlight_get_status
functions.summary: Read backlight brightness scaled to percent into props
functions.prose_contract: Precondition: dev's softc has a backlight device with max_brightness > 0. Postcondition: props->brightness is current brightness scaled to 0..100 and props->nlevels is 0; returns 0.
functions.model_hint: brightness as percent of max

functions.prose_contract: Precondition: dev's softc has a named backlight device. Postcondition: info->type is BACKLIGHT_TYPE_PANEL and info->name is the device name; returns 0.

functions.name: linux_backlight_update_status
functions.summary: Convert percent brightness to raw, set power, call backend update
functions.prose_contract: Precondition: props->brightness is 0..100 and dev's bd has ops->update_status. Postcondition: bd brightness is scaled to raw units, power reflects on/off, and the backend's update_status result is returned.
functions.model_hint: percent-to-raw scaling with power state

functions.name: linux_backlight_device_register
functions.summary: Allocate and initialize backlight_device, register with backlight core
functions.prose_contract: Precondition: dev is a valid linuxkpi device and ops/props are valid. Postcondition: dev->bd is allocated, initialized, and returned; dev->backlight_dev is registered with the BSD backlight core.
functions.ownership: caller owns bd, freed via linux_backlight_device_unregister
functions.error_convention: no failure path; returns allocated bd

functions.name: linux_backlight_device_unregister
functions.summary: Destroy BSD backlight device and free bd and its name

functions.name: single_open

functions.model_hint: inverse of lkpi_cw_to_rx_bw on the canonical subset
